paper_title: First Constraints on the Photon Coupling of Axion-like Particles from Multimessenger Studies of the Neutron Star Merger GW170817
notes: Astrophysical (NS merger GW170817 + Fermi-LAT) constraint on ALP-photon coupling g_agamma vs m_a; NOT a DM haloscope, so no local DM density. Main 95% CL exclusion is a closed region in the (m_a, g_agamma) plane (Fig. 4), roughly m_a ~ 20 MeV–1 GeV. Exact contour could not be read numerically from the paper; data_points are approximate boundary estimates anchored on the two stated benchmarks (BM1: m_a=398 MeV, g=5.01e-11 GeV^-1; BM2: m_a=200 MeV, g=1.41e-12 GeV^-1) and text descriptions. Fermi-LAT flux upper limit 4.5e-10 erg/cm^2/s used.
